briefdescription.para: NTR-01: forBindListen policy exhausts max_attempts → nextDelay() returns std::nullopt after the last attempt.
NTR-02: forConnectionIO delays are monotonically non-decreasing and bounded by max_delay_ms (no jitter can exceed the cap).
NTR-03: Queue depth never exceeds capacity — bounded memory guarantee.
NTR-04: After drain cycle, gate accepts new admits — no permanent stall.
NTR-05: Primary gRPC transport CLOSED → connection-closing error, signalling fallback must be attempted.
NTR-06: Both primary and fallback gRPC UNAVAILABLE → explicit TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE returned to caller; no silent data loss.
NTR-07: Pool DRAINING rejects new acquisitions (SERVER_DRAINING); in-flight count stays bounded and does not grow.
NTR-08: TCP CLOSED + WS UNAVAILABLE + QUIC FALLBACK_ACTIVE all active simultaneously — each path returns its correct code with no cross-path contamination.

detaileddescription.para:
Covers the three remaining Q4 2026 open items from src/network/ROADMAP.md § Phase 2: Multi-Transport Resilience:
Strengthen failure handling across TCP/WS/UDP/QUIC/gRPC paths.
Validate transport fallback/retry behavior under network degradation.
Expand transport-level regression coverage for mixed deployments (Planned Features § Short-term).
All tests are deterministic and self-contained — no live sockets.

sect2.title: Test Cases

para.heading: NTR-01..NTR-02 — Retry Policy Under Partial Connection Failure

sect2.para: NTR-01 WireRetryPolicy (forBindListen): exhausts max_attempts, then nextDelay() returns nullopt — caller must abort. NTR-02 WireRetryPolicy (forConnectionIO): transient error produces monotonically non-decreasing delays up to max_delay_ms.

NTR-03 Successive backpressure hits escalate — queue stays bounded (depth never exceeds capacity). NTR-04 After drain, the gate accepts new admits again — no permanent stall (queue depth returns to zero after drain cycle).

NTR-05 Primary gRPC transport CLOSED → error is connection-closing, fallback must be attempted. NTR-06 Fallback transport also UNAVAILABLE → TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE propagated to caller; no silent data loss.

para.heading: NTR-07 — Connection-Pool Drain Under Concurrent Reconnect

sect2.para: NTR-07 Pool in DRAINING state rejects new acquisitions (SERVER_DRAINING); in-flight count stays bounded during drain.
NTR-08 TCP CLOSED + WS UNAVAILABLE + QUIC FALLBACK_ACTIVE simultaneously: each path returns the correct error code; no cross-path contamination.
